title: Evaluation event log row (one row per tool call, draft v0.2)
description: Every evaluation item (E01-E16) reads from this log. Field names follow evaluation/README.md.

run_id.description: Groups rows from one harness run.

student_id.description: SIM- = simulated, ADV- = adversarial set, STU- = pseudonymous real student.

input_hash.description: sha256 of the canonical input JSON; used for caching and repeat-scoring (E02).

stages.description: v0.2: stage per sub-skill, keyed by sub-skill name. Replaces the fixed stage_* fields for new lessons; the v0.1 fields stay valid.

cost_usd.description: v0.2: null when the model's price is not configured (harness/bedrock_client.py PRICES_PER_MTOK), which is how run_eval.py already writes it.
